english.title: Fail to produce for inspection written permission to engage in activity on the Tyne and Wear Metro
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) whilst upon the Tyne and Wear Metro network and undertaking an activity referred to in byelaw 7(1) or 7(2)(iii)of the Tyne and Wear Metro Byelaws, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACTIVITY..), failed to

(A)_[hand over for inspection your written permission when asked by an authorised person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[comply with the conditions attached to your written permission]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 7(3) and 31(1) of the Tyne and Wear Metro Byelaws made under sections 58 and 62 of the Tyneside Metropolitan Railway Act 1973.

english.notes:
(i) Byelaw 30 make provisions in relation to name and addresses.
(ii) Byelaw 31(2) provides powers for the removal of persons.
(iii) Byelaw 31(3) provides that when using these powers, an authorised person, including a constable, must show his/her identification if requested.
(iv) Byelaw 31(4) provides that no person shall be subject to any penalty for breach of any of the Byelaws by disobeying a notice unless it is proved to the satisfaction of the Court before whom the complaint is laid that the notice referred to in the particular Byelaw was displayed.
(v) Byelaw 31(6) provides that an authorised person acting in the course of his duties shall not be liable for breach of this Byelaw.
(vi) When using these powers, an authorised person, must show his/her identification if requested.
